text:
maya: Heads-up  customers pushed two concrete asks for the Optimize toolkit: (A) alerting when eval suites show regression patterns, (B) lightweight client-side batching guidance for flaky mobile networks. We need a compact plan for next cycle. Proposal: priority to alert plumbing + PD/Slack hooks (beta), plus a small "batching helper" library with defaults. Keep quantization profiles out of the first ship. Agree?

ravi: +1 for narrow slice. Practical Q: do we define alerts only on eval metric deltas or also on sudden model output regressions (e.g., hallucination spike)? I prefer starting with eval deltas and a lightweight text-quality signal.

zoe: From ML: eval-delta templates are fastest. We can compute per-tenant baseline metrics and detect >X sigma deviations. Hallucination detectors are higher-recall/low-precision initially.

zoe: sketch rule:
```
if baseline_concordance - current_concordance > 0.06 AND sample_count >= 40 -> open alert
attach top_15 failing prompts + last_10 outputs
```

derek: Ops/infra note: core infra asks: tenant-scoped metric buckets, durable alert queue (retry semantics), a toggle to enable per-tenant beta, and a PD/Slack webhook tester. Also KV cache telemetry so we can show batching wins later. I can deliver canary toggles & queue in ~3 weeks.

jules: CS/customer ops: NovaCare wants PD + a "quiet window" feature (local timezone control). PicoMobile needs a tiny JS + Kotlin snippet that returns "batch now" recommendations. They asked for drop-in examples.

maya: Acceptance criteria suggestion (MVP):
- Alert pipeline raises signals for internal eval suite and produces reproducible samples
- PD & Slack delivery validated end-to-end for 2 beta tenants
- Console shows a compact alert list + one-click mute for tenant admins
- Batching helper + docs + example clients (JS/Kotlin) in docs repo
- Owner oncall assigned for first 14 days post-beta

maya: Quick owner callouts:
- infra: derek (queue, canary, webhooks)
- ml: zoe (templates, eval packs)
- ui: ravi (alert inbox + simple editor)
- cs: jules (beta coordination)

ravi: UI approach: simple template chooser (3 templates) + single numeric threshold and on/off toggle. No free-form rule builder for MVP. Inbox: compact list with sample payload preview. I'll prototype wireframes by Thu.

zoe: I'll prepare 3 starter templates: concordance_delta, auc_drop, and prompt_failure_rate. Will bundle a small labeled eval pack to validate templates. Planning to freeze templates in 5 days.

derek: I'll instrument per-tenant buckets and create a /v1/alerts/eval-diff?tenant=... endpoint for the UI. Also adding a canary toggle admin API. ETA: 3 weeks.

jules: I'll draft beta onboarding with PD webhook steps, timezone quiet window advice, and escalation matrix. Will ask NovaCare for their PD webhook and PicoMobile for a connection reliability trace by EOW.

maya: Rollout plan: internal-redwood -> NovaCare + PicoMobile (beta) -> list of early adopters. Target: beta in 5 weeks.

maya: Scope cut guidance: do not add advanced cost-anomaly detection, do not build a full rule-builder, and defer quantization profile recommendations to post-beta.

ravi: Metrics we should display in Console for beta: alert precision (manual-marked), median time-to-triage, and % alerts with attached repro. Those help CS and SRE tune thresholds.

zoe: Suggest adding an "auto-attach" of 10 failing prompts for quick triage and a link to run eval locally with the attached pack.

derek: For PD testing I'll add a webhook test endpoint and record delivery latencies. Will also add a retry policy for 5xx responses.

jules: Customer-facing artifact: short runbook + small checklist: enable alert for tenant, test PD webhook, verify samples attached, assign oncall. I'll own that.

bot-deploy: Calendar event created: "Optimize toolkit - beta readiness" for 2025-04-02 09:00 PT. Invited: maya, ravi, zoe, derek, jules.

maya: Thanks everyone. Meeting tomorrow 10am PT to finalize cut and owners. Goal: ship alert plumbing + batching helper into beta within ~5 weeks. If anyone suggests expanding scope to quant or cost-detection before beta please flag in thread. :rocket:
